provenance.kind: Project-authored controlled scientific study. All tables are stipulated model observations, not a claim of new experimental or ab-initio results.
provenance.scope: Inference is conditional on the explicit finite model, source identities, units and measurement policy.

model: Controlled additive unabsorbed stray-light model. Observed transmission T_obs=(10^(-epsilon*l*c)+f)/(1+f); A_obs=-log10(T_obs). The same positive f is independently calibrated, not fitted from this single sample. A finite nonnegative true concentration requires f/(1+f)<T_obs<=1.
target: Invert the sample absorbance, compare with naive Beer-Lambert inversion, compute the asymptotic maximum observable absorbance and assess whether the second reported transmission is compatible with any finite nonnegative concentration under this model. Do not clamp a negative recovered true transmission to force a finite answer.
scope: Stipulated optical instrument model, no scattering correction, new spectrum or real detection-limit claim.
